about.title: About Me
about.content: Frontend Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable, accessible, and high-performance web applications. Strong expertise in React, Tailwind CSS, modern UI architecture, and design systems. Experienced collaborating with U.S.-based teams in healthcare and SaaS environments, translating product requirements and Figma prototypes into performant, production-ready interfaces that drive business outcomes.

tas.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Develop accessible, high-performance web components for an internal design system used across multiple product teams.
Build UI features for a U.S. healthcare SaaS platform, improving usability and reducing operational friction for end users.
Increase frontend integration test coverage with Playwright, improving release confidence and reducing regression risk.
Review pull requests to ensure maintainability, architectural consistency, and pixel-perfect fidelity to Figma prototypes.
Maintain and publish private npm packages, accelerating development speed and promoting UI consistency across the platform.

freelance.title: Frontend Software Engineer
responsibilities: Developed high-performance landing pages and application interfaces that improved user acquisition and engagement.
Optimized student and administrative workflows through intuitive UI flows, reducing manual effort and increasing operational efficiency.
Implemented modern frontend architecture using React, React Query, and React Hook Form to ensure scalability and long-term maintainability.
Collaborated closely with product stakeholders to translate business requirements into user-centered solutions that supported company growth.

bymycell.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Built data visualization and reporting features using React and Tailwind CSS, enhancing clarity of laboratory analysis results.
Integrated frontend and backend systems to improve workflow traceability and reduce manual process errors.
Refactored legacy backend modules into a DDD-based architecture, improving scalability and long-term maintainability.
Implemented unit and integration tests to increase reliability and reduce production incidents.
Maintained legacy systems during architectural migration to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

take.title: Frontend Software Engineer
responsibilities: Developed backoffice features including order management, inventory control, and dashboards for smart retail coolers.
Contributed to the internal design system, increasing component reuse and accelerating feature delivery.
Implemented end-to-end testing with Cypress, reducing production bugs and increasing deployment confidence.
Built interactive dashboards and accessible data visualizations to support data-driven decision-making.
Collaborated with international clients, delivering production-ready features from planning to deployment.

suave.title: Full-stack Developer
responsibilities: Delivered high-performance Next.js landing pages focused on speed, responsiveness, and conversion optimization.
Developed custom website features that improved user experience and increased lead generation.
Built a multi-tenant social link aggregator platform using React and Express to support diverse client needs.
Performed SEO and performance optimizations that improved organic visibility and marketing ROI.

modularGameStore.title: Modular Game Store
modularGameStore.description: A modern, high-performance micro-frontend e-commerce platform built with Rspack and Module Federation, demonstrating scalable frontend architecture for large distributed teams.

marketPulse.description: A real-time financial market monitoring platform built with Lit, Lit Signals, Rspack, and Module Federation, designed to explore high-performance reactive UIs under streaming data loads.

animavita.description: Trigger life-saving alerts, register animals for adoption and find the closest pet friend to adopt. An open-source project with 739+ stars and 318+ forks on GitHub.
